The Gifting Problem
The aisle is full.
But it's empty
at the same time.

You've walked through the supermarket. Picked up the same candle. The same card. The same "oh-that's-nice" that wilts in three days — or sits in a drawer forever.

A gift should feel like a secret shared. Like someone actually paused and thought of you.

We paused. And we made something else.
🕯️💐🃏
Same gift. Again. And again.
Our Belief

"We believe gifts should feel like emotions,
not obligations."

"In a world where most gifts are bought in a hurry, wrapped without thought, and forgotten within days — we wanted to create something different."

Something slower. Something personal. Something that feels like effort.

At Tani & Tuft, we believe the best gifts are not always the most expensive ones. They're the ones that make people pause, smile, feel seen, and remember the moment long after it's gone.

That's why we create handcrafted flowers that never wilt, textured art pieces that spark conversations, and personalised creations that carry emotion in every detail.

Because a gift should never feel random. It should feel chosen.

  • Flowers can last longer than a week
  • Handmade things feel warmer
  • Effort is attractive
  • Thoughtful gifting matters
  • The smallest details often become the biggest memories
TANI & TUFT IS FOR PEOPLE WHO:
  • Care deeply
  • Love creatively
  • Celebrate thoughtfully
  • Never want their gifts to feel ordinary
✨ Handmade with intention.
Made to be remembered.

Founder's Message
"I never wanted Tani & Tuft to feel like just another gifting brand. I wanted it to feel personal."

The idea came from something simple — I realised that most gifts today feel rushed. People buy things because they have to, not because they truly want the other person to feel special. Somewhere between supermarket shelves, generic bouquets, and copy-paste gifting culture, the emotion behind gifting started disappearing.

That never felt right to me. So I started building Tani & Tuft with one belief: that a gift should feel like effort. Not expensive. Not flashy. Just thoughtful.

Something that makes someone pause and say: "Wait… this was made for me?"

Tani & Tuft is for people who still believe thoughtful things matter. Thank you for being here. Thank you for supporting handmade creativity. And thank you for helping us build a world with fewer boring gifts.

— Piyush Narang
Founder, Tani & Tuft
